svg.title: Server first flight against the transport limits
svg.desc: Measured server first flights with hybrid key exchange: classical 3,020 bytes; ML-DSA-44 leaf only 12,918; ML-DSA-44 full chain 17,169; ML-DSA-65 full chain 22,916. A QUIC server may send about 7,200 bytes before the client proves its address; TCP sends about 14,600 bytes in its first window.

text.tspan: bytes the server sends before it must wait for the client
